package migrations

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestHybridForwardDiscoveryNeverExecutesRollback(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	for file, sql := range map[string]string{"001_existing.sql": "SELECT 1;", "032_hybrid_application.up.sql": "CREATE TABLE forward_fixture(id int);", "032_hybrid_application.down.sql": "DROP TABLE forward_fixture;"} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, file), []byte(sql), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	actual, err := Discover(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(actual) != 2 || actual[0].Filename != "001_existing.sql" || actual[1].Filename != "032_hybrid_application.up.sql" {
		t.Fatalf("forward deployment selected rollback or lost legacy migration: %+v", actual)
	}
}
